verdict.rationale: Notion's REST API exposes nearly all workspace content, supports real-time webhooks for property/page changes, offers OAuth-based public connections, and documents an official MCP server — all of which enable other tools/agents to read and act on the same underlying data as a 'system of record,' reducing context loss during handoff. However, there is no first-hand or independent evidence of an actual multi-agent handoff scenario working smoothly, and community feedback highlights gaps (e.g., missing GitHub integration, workspace block limits) that could disrupt context continuity. Missing for 10: concrete case studies or hands-on proof of agent-to-agent handoff preserving full context, and independent corroboration beyond vendor docs.
